description: Retrieves Shared Data by HTTP GET on the shared-data resource URI.
normative_statements: The Service Consumer shall send an HTTP GET request to the resource URI "shared-data/{sharedDataId}".
The URI parameter sharedDataId shall identify the requested Shared Data.
On success, the NRF shall return 200 OK with the requested Shared Data in the response body.
On failure, the NRF shall return a 4xx or 5xx response.
In case of redirection, the NRF shall return a 3xx status code.
In case of redirection, the NRF shall include a Location header containing a URI pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance.
